title: tokens.purchased
description: Published by the ledger when a client buys tokens for a service from its main wallet (data model §5's Events table, task 3.4), in the same transaction as the purchase and its lot. Token quantities and prices are decimal strings (numeric(18,6)); money is in minor units. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

account_id.description: The service wallet the tokens went into.

minor_per_token.description: The price locked in the lot.

token_price_id.description: The list, tier or deal row used.
